title: mining hammer
description: Craftable Hammers from wooden tools up to netherite allowing players to mine in a 3 x 3 grid when mining.
body:
Allows players to break 3x3 mining blocks such as (stone, ores, etc).

The icon may look like a mace, but it's a pickaxe from wooden tools all the way up to netherite allowing players to mine looking up, down, left & right for better mining experience!

Recipes to craft hammer
- x2 sticks
- x3 [logs] for wooden
- x3 [stone] for stone
- x3 [copper], [iron], [gold], [diamond], & [netherite] blocks to craft hammer.
